source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.1.2 (PDF 209), with a note on Pakistan's regulator (DRAP).

blocks.text: Drug development woh amal hai jis mein dhoondi gayi dawa ko test kiya jata aur awaam ke istemal ke liye tayyar kiya jata hai. Nayi dawa tayyar karne ke yeh marhale hain:

Insanon par trial se pehle compounds ko in vitro (lab mein cells ke culture par) aur in vivo (janwaron par) test kiya jata hai taa ke un ki hifazat (safety), zehreela pan (toxicity) aur asar (efficacy) naapa ja sake.
Dawaen insanon par test ki jati hain taa ke un ki hifazat yaqeeni ho.

items: Phase 1: chhote group (20–100) sehatmand razakaron (healthy volunteers) par test, taa ke hifazat aur khurak (dosage) tay ho.
Phase 2: bare group (100–300) mareezon par test, taa ke dawa ka asar aur side effects (zimni asraat) dekhe jayen.
Phase 3: bohat bare trials (1,000–3,000 mareez), taa ke asar ki tasdeeq ho aur nuqsan wale rad-e-amal (adverse reactions) par nazar rakhi jaye.

blocks.text: Regulatory agencies (jaise America mein FDA ya Europe mein EMA) clinical trials ka tamam data ghaur se jaanchti hain aur market mein bhejne se pehle dawa ko manzoor (approve) ya radd (reject) karti hain.
Manzoori ke baad dawa pharmaceutical industries mein bare paimane par banti hai aur ilaaj ke liye dastiyab ki jati hai.
Market mein aane ke baad bhi dawa par musalsal nazar rakhi jati hai taa ke lambe arse ke asraat aur kam hone wale (rare) side effects ka pata chale aur logon ki hifazat jaari rahe.
Kitab FDA (United States) aur EMA (Europe) ka naam leti hai. Pakistan mein dawaon ki registration aur nigrani Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP) karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa clinical trial phase 100–300 mareezon par dawa ka asar aur side effects jaanchta hai?

items: Preclinical (cells aur janwar), phir clinical trials: phase 1 (20–100 sehatmand), phase 2 (100–300 mareez), phase 3 (1,000–3,000).
FDA/EMA review, manufacturing aur marketing, post-marketing surveillance.
